changes_from_v2: Versioned shared trigger/operation contract and prompt contrasts
Unknown records quarantined; exact duplicate checks and obligation provenance routing
Eligible binding IDs in selection schema and specific bounded retry feedback
Additive outcome/request/version metadata; historical source verification; one-method report scope

cost.call_breakdown: 8 extraction + 8 selection opportunities, each with at most 1 retry. A2 controller queries incur no extra model invocation; tool evidence enters that checkpoint selection.
cost.caveat: Planning only. Token/byte ratio comes from the failed live smoke; populated-ledger sizes come from a restricted-language mock. No live extraction improvement or tokenizer upper bound is inferred.
cost.guard_note: Durable reservations for every attempt, never refunded. Oversized requests stop before inference, without truncation. A conservative allowance is not a guarantee that all possible histories fit the byte limit.

decision_rule: Report scoreability separately from integration criteria. A perfect score is not required for a scoreable run. Retain all failures and official TP/FP/FN; no selective rerun. At most narrow integration feasibility, never reliability or superiority.
exposure: Already-inspected development trajectory including the failed live smoke. Not held-out evidence.
full_study: The old 12-trajectory freeze does not authorize or describe v2.1. Any later full study needs its own matching implementation/configuration freeze and explicit authorization.
hypothesis: The shared extraction contract can admit supported intentions, reject unsupported menu-only creation, and allow the existing A2 monitor, selector and receipt lifecycle to operate in one complete real-model trajectory.
observable_criteria: All 8 checkpoints logged; incomplete trajectory is reported incomplete, no imputed actions.
Supported instructions create traceable intentions; compare actual ledger action/trigger/dependency fields with legitimate source observations.
No intention is created solely from a menu, hypothetical or quoted third-party instruction; manually inspect semantic support, not only source matching.
Each validation failure/retry/empty update is visible and accounted; no silent fallback success.
Monitor tickets reference actual eligible ledger IDs/versions and permitted channels; negative evidence can be followed by a later permitted check.
Selected handles are bound to current intentions and supported by available current evidence; missing/negative evidence is not fabricated.
Completion occurs only after a successful simulator receipt; dependencies remain blocked until prerequisite completion.

provider_capabilities.advertised_structured_outputs: Observed in saved pinned-route metadata; not refreshed with credentials in this repair.
provider_capabilities.exact_keyword_acceptance_and_enforcement: UNVERIFIED on the pinned endpoint; local enforcement tested independently. Public docs do not certify these keywords for this exact route. No inference probe performed.
provider_capabilities.failure_policy: Future authorized launcher checks nonbillable route metadata over verified TLS; no fallback or schema relaxation. Any transport/API rejection stops and retains reservation.
provider_capabilities.pinned: deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1 via OpenRouter, Novita only, fp8, no fallbacks, require_parameters=true, reasoning disabled/excluded

selection_schema_note: Binding intention/handle enums and empty-ledger array limits are derived only from the public ledger/menu. Exact per-request schemas are logged.
unchanged: One query per checkpoint, heartbeat disabled, monitoring scheduling policy
Execution receipts and official scorer; historical A0/A1 prompts and artifacts

validation.context: Exact cited spans, non-menu visible obligation source, field evidence, available channels, current versions, dependencies and receipt lifecycle.
validation.empty_updates: Accepted empty update distinguished from accepted operations, rejection, retry exhaustion and transport failure in every response log.
validation.exhaustion: Explicit fail-closed checkpoint with no task action; retained validation failures. Transport failure stops the study.
validation.semantics: Single extractor interprets delegation/action/trigger; no deterministic entailment guarantee. Narrative hypothetical test intentionally demonstrates the limit.
validation.structure: One shared JSON Schema in contract.py; common.validate enforces its local subset for parse and Store.apply.
validation.transaction: Entire extraction batch atomic; any rejection rolls back all operations/events. No partial acceptance.
validation.unresolved: Supported unknown-trigger records quarantined; no action or polling until resolved by revision.
